name: backlink-checker
description: Does a page link to your domain? Dofollow/nofollow, anchor, status, robots guards. Live, no store.
long_description: Fetches a referring page live and reports whether it links to a target domain: dofollow or nofollow, anchor text, HTTP status and page-level robots guards (meta robots / X-Robots-Tag). link_check covers one URL, link_audit a list with a per-URL table (free tier: 3 URLs per call), robots_guard_check the guards alone. Every check is a fresh fetch; nothing is stored, nothing is sent anywhere except the URL you asked about.
